title: Stateless JWT-form GitHub App installation token
summary: A synthetic ghs_ token of the form ghs_APPID_JWT: a placeholder app id, an underscore and a three-segment JWT with two dots, about 520 characters in total, in a bare form and in JSON, Authorization, URL, Korean/emoji and CRLF carriers.
rationale: GitHub began issuing this form on 2026-04-27 and documents it in prose and as a regular expression. A matcher built for the 40-character opaque form, or one that stops at the first dot or underscore, cuts the token short or misses it. The value is shaped by the documented grammar; being a well-formed JWT is not proof of issuance and the value was never issued.

expectation.rationale: Flagged, covering the whole token from ghs_ to the end of the last JWT segment. The provider documents the prefix, the ghs_APPID_JWT notation, the two dots and the recommended expression; this rests on that lexical grammar only.

sources.supports: ghs_APPID_JWT notation; about 520 characters; applications relying on exactly 40 characters may break.
Stateless token is a ghs_-prefixed JWT with two dots; recommended expression ghs_[A-Za-z0-9\.\-_]{36,}.
sources.locator: How to use it; Verifying the token type

sources.supports: Staged rollout of ghs_APPID_JWT and the warning about relying on exactly 40 characters.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
